data.title: Meowdoku Solver
data.statement:
Meowdoku is a cat puzzle played on a square board having [[n]] x [[n]] cells. Each cell belongs to one of [[n]] contiguous color regions on the board. Color regions are polyominos, which are connected cells of the same color with horizontal/vertical connections.

You must find the cell positions of [[n]] cats, using the following rules:

1. There is exactly one cat per row.
2. There is exactly one cat per column.
3. There is exactly one cat per color region.
4. The cats do not touch diagonally.

The minimum board size is 4 x 4, since there is no solution for smaller board sizes.

To understand Meowdoku better, you can play it online here: {{https://www.meowdoku.org/}}

In this version of the puzzle, the [[n]] colors are provided as distinct uppercase letters, starting with {{A}}.

Given an [[n]] x [[n]] Meowdoku board, find the unique solution that allows placing [[n]] cats on [[n]] different cells on the board, using the rules above. Output the board, using the original letters, but using lowercase letters instead of uppercase letters for cells with a cat.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Meowdoku is a cat puzzle played on a square board having n x n cells. Each cell belongs to one of n contiguous color regions on the board. Color regions are polyominos, which are connected cells of the same color with horizontal/vertical connections.

You must find the cell positions of n cats, using the following rules:

1. There is exactly one cat per row.
2. There is exactly one cat per column.
3. There is exactly one cat per color region.
4. The cats do not touch diagonally.

The minimum board size is 4 x 4, since there is no solution for smaller board sizes.

To understand Meowdoku better, you can play it online here: https://www.meowdoku.org/

In this version of the puzzle, the n colors are provided as distinct uppercase letters, starting with A.

Given an n x n Meowdoku board, find the unique solution that allows placing n cats on n different cells on the board, using the rules above. Output the board, using the original letters, but using lowercase letters instead of uppercase letters for cells with a cat.
Input
Line 1: The size n of the square Meowdoku board
Next n lines: The rows of the Meowdoku board, using different uppercase letters for different color regions, using a space between columns
Output
n lines: The solved rows of the Meowdoku board, using the original uppercase letters (but in lowercase where a cat is placed), using a space between columns
Constraints
4 <= n <= 23
Example
Input
4
C C C B
D D D B
A D D D
A D D D
Output
C c C B
D D D b
a D D D
A D d D
